quote: Don't kid yourself. President Obama's decision to withdraw 33,000 troops from Afghanistan before he stands for reelection is not driven by the United States' 'position of strength' in the war zone as much as it is by grim economic and political realities at home.
author: Ron Fournier

quote: Strength of character may be learned at work, but beauty of character is learned at home.
author: Henry Drummond

quote: I have always drawn strength from being close to home.
author: Arthur Ashe

quote: Take, for example, the African jungle, the home of the cheetah. On whom does the cheetah prey? The old, the sick, the wounded, the weak, the very young, but never the strong. Lesson: If you would not be prey, you had better be strong.
author: G. Gordon Liddy

quote: A strong mind always hopes, and has always cause to hope.
author: Thomas Carlyle

quote: I hope we shall crush in its birth the aristocracy of our monied corporations which dare already to challenge our government to a trial by strength, and bid defiance to the laws of our country.
author: Thomas Jefferson

quote: Obama won the presidency on the strength of his message and the skills of the messenger. Now the talk of hope and change feels out of tune when so many Americans are out of work, over-mortgaged, and worried that life will be even tougher for their children.
author: Ron Fournier

quote: Do you force your kids to pay attention to what's going on, or do you let them live their lives outside of it? My hope is that my child is a strong activist. That would make me most proud.
author: Eddie Vedder

quote: Families are the tie that reminds us of yesterday, provide strength and support today, and give us hope for tomorrow. No government, no matter how well-intentioned, or well-managed, can provide what our families provide.
author: Bill Owens

quote: Courage is sometimes frail as hope is frail: a fragile shoot between two stones that grows brave toward the sun though warmth and brightness fail, striving and faith the only strength it knows.
author: Frances Rodman

quote: Don't wish me happiness - I don't expect to be happy it's gotten beyond that, somehow. Wish me courage and strength and a sense of humor - I will need them all.
author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

quote: If the blood humor is too strong and robust, calm it with balance and harmony.
author: Xun Zi

quote: I love a man with a great sense of humor and who is intelligent - a man who has a great smile. He has to make me laugh. I like a man who is very ambitious and driven and who has a good heart and makes me feel safe. I like a man who is very strong and independent and confident - that is very sexy - but at the same time, he's very kind to people.
author: Nicole Scherzinger

quote: There's something about Southern women that is so unique yet so universal. Strong southern women are allowed to be soft and feminine and have a sense of humor. But what I love about Southern women in particular is their universality.
author: Connie Britton

quote: What really fascinates me is this need that is so strong now that if you read a work of the imagination you instantly have to say, 'Oh, what this really is is so-and-so,' reducing it to a simple formula.
author: Doris Lessing

quote: My greatest strength as a child, I realize now, was my imagination. While every other kid was reading and writing, I had seven whole hours a day to practice my imagination. When do you get that space in your life, ever?
author: Barbara Corcoran

quote: As an actor you have to have a strong vivid imagination as you're working and when the camera's rolling, but there's certainly a part of you that is aware of real life, that you're making a movie.
author: John Hawkes

quote: It's not only imagination, it's the distortion of the vision. You suddenly think, This person is idealistic, this person is strong, this person has dreams, when you know better most of the time. You put what you want to see on people.
author: Olivier Martinez

quote: Just about this time, when in imagination I was so great a warrior, I had good use in real life for more strength, as I was no longer taken to school by the nurse, but instead had myself to protect my brother, two years my junior.
author: Georg Brandes

quote: I think I'm an actor because I have very strong imagination and empathy. I never studied acting, but those two qualities are exactly the qualities that make for an activist.
author: Susan Sarandon

quote: Our imaginations are strong as children. Sometimes they get shoved aside, these imaginations. They get dusty and mildewed with age. The imagination is a muscle that has to be put to use or it shrivels.
author: Julianna Baggott

quote: But there is so much more to do for the city we love... a Dallas with roads as strong as our businesses, parks as beautiful as our children, a downtown as tall as our imagination.
author: Laura Miller

quote: I believe in pink. I believe that laughing is the best calorie burner. I believe in kissing, kissing a lot. I believe in being strong when everything seems to be going wrong. I believe that happy girls are the prettiest girls. I believe that tomorrow is another day and I believe in miracles.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: Nothing makes one feel so strong as a call for help.
author: Pope Paul VI

quote: Character is higher than intellect. A great soul will be strong to live as well as think.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Continuous effort - not strength or intelligence - is the key to unlocking our potential.
author: Winston Churchill

quote: If you are going to have to play defense all the time, you cannot have the kind of ingenuity, assertiveness, independence, and intelligence which is what has made our country strong.
author: Arlen Specter

quote: If I could have been a marine biologist I would have, but I didn't have that kind of intelligence. Numbers were never my strong point.
author: Nicolas Cage

quote: I want to exude strength and intelligence.
author: Portia de Rossi

quote: When I went on to write my next book, Working With Emotional Intelligence, I wanted to make a business case that the best performers were those people strong in these skills.
author: Daniel Goleman

quote: There is a lot of strength and intelligence in Hollywood.
author: Fay Wray

quote: The actions that we take on the counterterrorism front, again, are to take actions against individuals where we believe that the intelligence base is so strong and the nature of the threat is so grave and serious, as well as imminent, that we have no recourse except to take this action that may involve a lethal strike.
author: John O. Brennan

quote: Lincoln's stature and strength, his intelligence and ambition - in short, all the elements which gave him popularity among men in New Salem, rendered him equally attractive to the fair sex of that village.
author: John George Nicolay

quote: There is never jealousy where there is not strong regard.
author: Washington Irving

quote: Knowledge is not a passion from without the mind, but an active exertion of the inward strength, vigor and power of the mind, displaying itself from within.
author: Ralph Cudworth

quote: The difference between a successful person and others is not a lack of strength, not a lack of knowledge, but rather a lack of will.
author: Vince Lombardi

quote: Three passions, simple but overwhelmingly strong, have governed my life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: The apple cannot be stuck back on the Tree of Knowledge once we begin to see, we are doomed and challenged to seek the strength to see more, not less.
author: Arthur Miller

quote: My practicality consists in this, in the knowledge that if you beat your head against the wall it is your head which breaks and not the wall - that is my strength, my only strength.
author: Antonio Gramsci

quote: This means that no single logic is strong enough to support the total construction of human knowledge.
author: Jean Piaget

quote: Wisdom is the knowledge of good and evil, not the strength to choose between the two.
author: John Cheever

quote: Wisdom we know is the knowledge of good and evil, not the strength to choose between the two.
author: John Cheever

quote: I love sharing my knowledge of hitting with others. Now coaches and players at all levels can learn my systematic approach to hitting a baseball with more consistency, mental strength and accuracy.
author: Dusty Baker

quote: Strong convictions precede great actions.
author: James Freeman Clarke

quote: It's really necessary for the United States to continue to give strong leadership to the Middle East peace process, supported by European countries at the same time.
author: William Hague

quote: If America wants to retain its position as a global power, its president must listen to the people and show strong leadership at this turning point in human history.
author: David Suzuki

quote: I think President Obama could have handled politics and policies differently. But he has been decisive, strong, and consistent - important qualities in a president. Mitt Romney is indeed an Etch A Sketch, the antithesis of leadership.
author: Eliot Spitzer

quote: I talked about the need for American leadership, I talked about the importance of the United States to a more peaceful world, a world that has been quite turbulent in recent years, and needs a strong American anchor.
author: Condoleezza Rice

quote: All Americans and freedom-loving people around the world owe President Reagan our deepest gratitude for his strong, principled leadership that ended the Cold War and brought freedom to millions of people.
author: Jim Ramstad

quote: If Ralph Nader runs, President Bush is going to be re-elected, and if Ralph Nader doesn't run, President Bush is going to be re-elected. We're going to run on the president's strong and principled leadership and his positive agenda for a second term.
author: Ed Gillespie

quote: So I think that our foreign policy, the president's strong and principled leadership when it comes to the war against terror and foreign policy is going to be an asset.
author: Ed Gillespie

quote: Under the leadership of this President, the state of the union is not strong. We are being pulled apart rather than pulling together. Our democracy is suffering from the choices being made, and yet we are offered the same tired excuses and unrealistic analyses.
author: Jose Serrano

quote: Preparing our city to achieve its destiny will require strong leadership.
author: Thomas Menino

quote: I am delighted with the strong vote I have received. My message of positive leadership, patriotism and commitment clearly was resonating with tens of thousands of ordinary Irish people.
author: Michael D. Higgins

quote: I believe that the will of the people is resolved by a strong leadership. Even in a democratic society, events depend on a strong leadership with a strong power of persuasion, and not on the opinion of the masses.
author: Yitzhak Shamir

quote: I think that all areas of the budget have to be scrubbed. Clearly the entitlement issues have to be reformed and that's an issue that's going to require I think some strong bipartisan cooperation and leadership.
author: John Thune

quote: The longer we go without strong leadership from the Administration and until we see significant progress in the day-to-day lives of the Iraqi people, the more difficult it will become to sustain the support of the American people and Congress for the current course.

quote: The House has passed several bipartisan bills to ensure all Americans have the opportunity to secure a good job to provide for their families. All of these jobs bills deserve the support of our Senators and a strong show of leadership from the president.
author: Joe Heck

quote: We do not need international help to stop corruption, we need strong Louisiana Leadership.
author: David Vitter

quote: Now learning a bit more about footballers I think what they need to do well, is someone who really wants to stay in the background and just be a strong support.
author: Anna Friel

quote: Learning how to get in tune with your field of energy and understand how to create your energy, expand that energy, and move that energy through your body. author: Erin Gray

quote: An important aspect of the current situation is the strong social reaction against suggestions that the home language of African American children be used in the first steps of learning to read and write.
author: William Labov

quote: How far you go in life depends on your being tender with the young, compassionate with the aged, sympathetic with the striving and tolerant of the weak and strong. Because someday in your life you will have been all of these.
author: George Washington Carver

quote: When you rise in the morning, give thanks for the light, for your life, for your strength. Give thanks for your food and for the joy of living. If you see no reason to give thanks, the fault lies in yourself.
author: Tecumseh

author: Vincent Van Gogh

quote: If you like small government you need to work hard at having a strong national defense that is not so militant. author: Ron Paul

quote: Three passions, simple but overwhelmingly strong, have governed my life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: I have found it easier to identify with the characters who verge upon hysteria, who were frightened of life, who were desperate to reach out to another person. But these seemingly fragile people are the strong people really.
author: Tennessee Williams

quote: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: Love many things, for therein lies the true strength, and whosoever loves much performs much, and can accomplish much, and what is done in love is done well.
author: Vincent Van Gogh

quote: Love you will find only where you may show yourself weak without provoking strength.
author: Theodor Adorno

quote: I love those who can smile in trouble, who can gather strength from distress, and grow brave by reflection. 'Tis the business of little minds to shrink, but they whose heart is firm, and whose conscience approves their conduct, will pursue their principles unto death.

quote: I love the man that can smile in trouble, that can gather strength from distress, and grow brave by reflection. 'Tis the business of little minds to shrink, but he whose heart is firm, and whose conscience approves his conduct, will pursue his principles unto death.
author: Thomas Paine

quote: I have a very strong feeling that the opposite of love is not hate - it's apathy. It's not giving a damn.
author: Leo Buscaglia

quote: It is cruel, you know, that music should be so beautiful. It has the beauty of loneliness of pain: of strength and freedom. The beauty of disappointment and never-satisfied love. The cruel beauty of nature and everlasting beauty of monotony.

quote: Three passions, simple but overwhelmingly strong, have governed my life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind.
author: Bertrand Russell

quote: Love feels no burden, thinks nothing of trouble, attempts what is above its strength, pleads no excuse of impossibility for it thinks all things lawful for itself, and all things possible.
author: Thomas a Kempis

author: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

author: Elisabeth Shue

quote: He who knows no hardships will know no hardihood. He who faces no calamity will need no courage. Mysterious though it is, the characteristics in human nature which we love best grow in a soil with a strong mixture of troubles.
author: Harry Emerson Fosdick

quote: You know what's funny? I don't ever feel the need to escape. I have a strong marriage. I like my life. You hear about these guys having midlife crises - I don't see that happening to me.
author: Harry Connick, Jr.

quote: I'm an activist for gay marriage equality and children's rights. I'm the face of Share Our Strength.
author: Sandra Lee

quote: Love is not weakness. It is strong. Only the sacrament of marriage can contain it.
author: Boris Pasternak

quote: I guess because the shows were activist in their own way - the marriage of my public activism and my career activism, you know - people understand me very well. They also understand there's a very strong bipartisan part in all of this.
author: Norman Lear

quote: I think long-lasting, healthy relationships are more important than the idea of marriage. At the root of every successful marriage is a strong partnership.
author: Carson Daly

quote: The old welfare system was hurting people by discouraging work and marriage. Welfare reform, and now this legislation, will build on the understanding that work and strong families are the foundation upon which we build our future.
author: Jim Talent

quote: Instead, I think over the years we have cut the strength of marriage and relationships by the law and weakened the institution. We have tried to deal with relationships with no-fault divorce, with child custody, with so many other avenues and it has not helped.
author: Timothy Murphy

quote: The main reason for the failure of the modern medical science is that it is dealing with results and not causes. Nothing more than the patching up of those attacked and the burying of those who are slain, without a thought being given to the real strong hold.
author: Edward Bach

quote: It is easier to build strong children than to repair broken men.
author: Frederick Douglass

quote: I, with a deeper instinct, choose a man who compels my strength, who makes enormous demands on me, who does not doubt my courage or my toughness, who does not believe me naive or innocent, who has the courage to treat me like a woman.
author: Anais Nin

quote: The beauty of a strong, lasting commitment is often best understood by men incapable of it.
author: Murray Kempton

quote: I think men are afraid to be with a successful woman, because we are terribly strong, we know what we want and we are not fragile enough.
author: Shirley Bassey

quote: Women may fall when there's no strength in men.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Shallow men believe in luck. Strong men believe in cause and effect.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Women have always been the strong ones of the world. The men are always seeking from women a little pillow to put their heads down on. They are always longing for the mother who held them as infants.
author: Coco Chanel

quote: Men's actions are too strong for them. Show me a man who has acted, and who has not been the victim and slave of his action.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Women must tell men always that they are the strong ones. They are the big, the strong, the wonderful. In truth, women are the strong ones. It is just my opinion, I am not a professor.
author: Coco Chanel

quote: Don't wait for extraordinary opportunities. Seize common occasions and make them great. Weak men wait for opportunities strong men make them.
author: Orison Swett Marden

quote: Welcome to Lake Wobegon, where all the women are strong, all the men are good-looking, and all the children are above average.
author: Garrison Keillor

quote: You can tell the strength of a nation by the women behind its men.
author: Benjamin Disraeli

quote: Great occasions do not make heroes or cowards they simply unveil them to the eyes of men. Silently and imperceptibly, as we wake or sleep, we grow strong or weak and at last some crisis shows what we have become.
author: Brooke Foss Westcott

quote: It is funny that men who are supposed to be scientific cannot get themselves to realise the basic principle of physics, that action and reaction are equal and opposite, that when you persecute people you always rouse them to be strong and stronger.
author: Gertrude Stein

quote: Strong beliefs win strong men, and then make them stronger.
author: Richard Bach

quote: Men are strong so long as they represent a strong idea they become powerless when they oppose it.
author: Sigmund Freud

quote: I was surrounded by strong women so it had never even occurred to me that women were anything other than equal to men.
author: David Bailey

quote: We are all strong enough to bear other men's misfortunes.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quote: A strong hatred is the best lamp to bear in our hands as we go over the dark places of life, cutting away the dead things men tell us to revere.
author: Rebecca West

quote: Men should be like Kleenex, soft, strong and disposable.
author: Cher

quote: The strength and power of a country depends absolutely on the quantity of good men and women in it.
author: John Ruskin

quote: The 'morality of compromise' sounds contradictory. Compromise is usually a sign of weakness, or an admission of defeat. Strong men don't compromise, it is said, and principles should never be compromised.
author: Andrew Carnegie

quote: Every woman needs one man in her life who is strong and responsible. Given this security, she can proceed to do what she really wants to do-fall in love with men who are weak and irresponsible.
author: Richard J. Needham

quote: Strong women only marry weak men.
author: Bette Davis

quote: That strong mother doesn't tell her cub, Son, stay weak so the wolves can get you. She says, Toughen up, this is reality we are living in.
author: Lauryn Hill

quote: My mother taught me about the power of inspiration and courage, and she did it with a strength and a passion that I wish could be bottled.
author: Carly Fiorina

quote: My mom was such a strong character. I don't want to say she was like a man, but she was tough.
author: Lance Armstrong

quote: I feel like a good mom. I'm a strong woman now... Don't look down on me. Pray for me because I'm trying.
author: Fantasia Barrino

quote: Because sorry to say, women run the house. They run the family. They hold things up. I mean, it's like you don't ever see your mom get sick because she handles everything. And it's kind of amazing I think to show people just how strong women are.
author: Sophia Bush

quote: My mom died when I was 16. I had a rough childhood, you know what I mean, but it made me strong.
author: Travis Barker

quote: If I could be a third of the woman that my mom is and have a third of the strength that she has, then I will have done good by this life.
author: Brittany Murphy

quote: As a small business owner for the last 15 years, when I think of what truly changed my life, it was my faith, a strong family, my mom did a really, really good job of encouraging me in very clear and discernible ways.
author: Tim Scott

quote: I was raised in Boston by three older brothers and a very strong and empowering single mom.
author: Eliza Dushku

quote: My mother was a single mom, and most of the women I know are strong.
author: Regina King

quote: I've always believed fitness is an entry point to help you build that happier, healthier life. When your health is strong, you're capable of taking risks. You'll feel more confident to ask for the promotion. You'll have more energy to be a better mom. You'll feel more deserving of love.
author: Jillian Michaels

quote: Growing up with three older brothers and being the youngest and the only girl, my mom always made me tough. She's taught me over the years how to be a strong, independent woman, how to carry yourself in a positive way and anything that my brothers can do, I can do.
author: Diana Lopez

quote: My mom was a source of strength.She showed me by example that women, regardless of how difficult life may get, can do it all.
author: Gloria Estefan

quote: I was born and raised in the high desert of Nevada in a tiny town called Searchlight. My dad was a hard rock miner. My mom took in wash. I grew up around people of strong values - even if they rarely talked about them.
author: Harry Reid

quote: My father left... but I tell my mom - and I told my mom this when I was a kid - I said, 'You know what, Mom? Good thing he left because you're a strong woman.'
author: J. R. Martinez

quote: My mom still lives in Denver and some of my brothers are still in the area, so I still have strong ties there.
author: Terrell Davis

quote: My mom was a professional fitness competitor, so I go into the gym with her. I train with my dad and mother. It's embarrassing, because she's really strong.
author: Booboo Stewart

quote: If you put all your strength and faith and vigor into a job and try to do the best you can, the money will come.
author: Lawrence Welk

quote: Let us face it: in the world today, money and economic strength remain more powerful arguments than the number of people you represent.
author: Guy Verhofstadt

quote: When you rise in the morning, give thanks for the light, for your life, for your strength. Give thanks for your food and for the joy of living. If you see no reason to give thanks, the fault lies in yourself.
author: Tecumseh

quote: You know, I looked at my face in the mirror this morning, and I like being old. My face has more content and when I train in the gym now, I am not training to be strong or handsome - just better than I was yesterday. These days the race is just against myself.
author: Jean Claude Van Damme

quote: Early in the morning, I fell in love with the girl that later on became my wife. At that time, we were so naive. I wanted to charm her, so I read her Capital by Marx. I thought somehow she would be convinced by the strength of his criticism about capital.
author: Shimon Peres

quote: I exercise every morning. I do light weights - 5lb and 10lb arm exercises - and then lie and lift my arms and legs. It's all about keeping core strength. I do a lot of stretching too.
author: Larry Hagman

quote: Another very strong image from the first day was giving my initial press conference in the morning - going down and finding out that everything I had said, the essence of what I had said, was wrong.
author: William Scranton

quote: With the new day comes new strength and new thoughts.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quote: Bruce Lee was very famous. I watched his movies and he is amazing. He is a martial arts master, his philosophy, his movement, both physically and mentally, were very strong.
author: Jet Li

quote: I really care about this stuff, I care about movies, and you just have to be strong and don't be stupid freedom of choice is a big responsibility, and I'm lucky enough not to have to just take any movie to pay the rent, so there's no need to be greedy.
author: Jonah Hill

quote: I do like strong women in my movies. I have five sisters, so I've just grown up with that model.
author: Robert Rodriguez

quote: It is cruel, you know, that music should be so beautiful. It has the beauty of loneliness of pain: of strength and freedom. The beauty of disappointment and never-satisfied love. The cruel beauty of nature and everlasting beauty of monotony.
author: Benjamin Britten

quote: Music makes us want to live. You don't know how many times people have told me that they'd been down and depressed and just wanted to die. But then a special song caught their ear and that helped give them renewed strength. That's the power music has.
author: Mary J. Blige

quote: Solitary trees, if they grow at all, grow strong.
author: Winston Churchill

quote: Nature is so powerful, so strong. Capturing its essence is not easy - your work becomes a dance with light and the weather. It takes you to a place within yourself.
author: Annie Leibovitz

quote: Each blade of grass has its spot on earth whence it draws its life, its strength and so is man rooted to the land from which he draws his faith together with his life.
author: Joseph Conrad

quote: A strong body makes the mind strong. As to the species of exercises, I advise the gun. While this gives moderate exercise to the body, it gives boldness, enterprise and independence to the mind. Games played with the ball, and others of that nature, are too violent for the body and stamp no character on the mind. Let your gun therefore be your constant companion of your walks.
author: Thomas Jefferson

quote: It is cruel, you know, that music should be so beautiful. It has the beauty of loneliness of pain: of strength and freedom. The beauty of disappointment and never-satisfied love. The cruel beauty of nature and everlasting beauty of monotony.
author: Benjamin Britten

quote: Everybody needs beauty as well as bread, places to play in and pray in, where nature may heal and give strength to body and soul.
author: John Muir

quote: He who knows no hardships will know no hardihood. He who faces no calamity will need no courage. Mysterious though it is, the characteristics in human nature which we love best grow in a soil with a strong mixture of troubles.
author: Harry Emerson Fosdick

quote: I look at an ant and I see myself: a native South African, endowed by nature with a strength much greater than my size so I might cope with the weight of a racism that crushes my spirit.
author: Miriam Makeba

quote: It is the nature, and the advantage, of strong people that they can bring out the crucial questions and form a clear opinion about them. The weak always have to decide between alternatives that are not their own.
author: Dietrich Bonhoeffer

quote: No tendency is quite so strong in human nature as the desire to lay down rules of conduct for other people.
author: William Howard Taft

quote: Philosophy would render us entirely Pyrrhonian, were not nature too strong for it.
author: David Hume

quote: Age is not measured by years. Nature does not equally distribute energy. Some people are born old and tired while others are going strong at seventy.
author: Dorothy Thompson

quote: I cannot think of any need in childhood as strong as the need for a father's protection.
author: Sigmund Freud

quote: My mother was the influence in my life. She was strong she had great faith in the ultimate triumph of justice and hard work. She believed passionately in education.
author: John H. Johnson

quote: Endurance is nobler than strength, and patience than beauty.
author: John Ruskin

quote: Patience is the support of weakness impatience the ruin of strength.
author: Charles Caleb Colton

quote: If you would know strength and patience, welcome the company of trees.
author: Hal Borland

quote: Every great dream begins with a dreamer. Always remember, you have within you the strength, the patience, and the passion to reach for the stars to change the world.
author: Harriet Tubman

quote: Patience and time do more than strength or passion.
author: Jean de La Fontaine

quote: The days of our lives, for all of us, are numbered. We know that. And yes, there are certainly times when we aren't able to muster as much strength and patience as we would like. It's called being human.
author: Elizabeth Edwards

quote: I think you can judge from somebody's actions a kind of a stability and sense of purpose perhaps created by strong religious roots. I mean, there's a certain patience, a certain discipline, I think, that religion helps you achieve.
author: George W. Bush

quote: Patience was not my strong point.

quote: The strong manly ones in life are those who understand the meaning of the word patience.
author: Tokugawa Ieyasu

quote: Patience has never been my strong suit.
author: Michael Chiklis

quote: I look forward to a great future for America - a future in which our country will match its military strength with our moral restraint, its wealth with our wisdom, its power with our purpose.
author: John F. Kennedy

quote: We'll try to cooperate fully with the IRS, because, as citizens, we feel a strong patriotic duty not to go to jail.
author: Dave Barry

quote: Patriotism consists not in waving the flag, but in striving that our country shall be righteous as well as strong.
author: James Bryce

quote: Patriotism is strong nationalistic feeling for a country whose borders and whose legitimacy and whose ethnic composition is taken for granted.
author: Michael Ignatieff

quote: I am delighted with the strong vote I have received. My message of positive leadership, patriotism and commitment clearly was resonating with tens of thousands of ordinary Irish people.
author: Michael D. Higgins

quote: The world knows that America will never start a war. This generation of Americans has had enough of war and hate... we want to build a world of peace where the weak are secure and the strong are just.
author: John F. Kennedy

quote: War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.

quote: I love the man that can smile in trouble, that can gather strength from distress, and grow brave by reflection. 'Tis the business of little minds to shrink, but he whose heart is firm, and whose conscience approves his conduct, will pursue his principles unto death.
author: Thomas Paine

quote: The tax on capital gains directly affects investment decisions, the mobility and flow of risk capital... the ease or difficulty experienced by new ventures in obtaining capital, and thereby the strength and potential for growth in the economy.
author: John F. Kennedy

quote: Women may fall when there's no strength in men.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Do you really think it is weakness that yields to temptation? I tell you that there are terrible temptations which it requires strength, strength and courage to yield to.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: I look forward to a great future for America - a future in which our country will match its military strength with our moral restraint, its wealth with our wisdom, its power with our purpose.
author: John F. Kennedy

quote: It is my own firm belief that the strength of the soul grows in proportion as you subdue the flesh.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: When restraint and courtesy are added to strength, the latter becomes irresistible.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

quote: The strength of a nation derives from the integrity of the home.
author: Confucius

quote: Love many things, for therein lies the true strength, and whosoever loves much performs much, and can accomplish much, and what is done in love is done well.
author: Vincent Van Gogh

quote: Climbing to the top demands strength, whether it is to the top of Mount Everest or to the top of your career.
author: Abdul Kalam

quote: War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.
author: George Orwell

quote: We gain the strength of the temptation we resist.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: It is cruel, you know, that music should be so beautiful. It has the beauty of loneliness of pain: of strength and freedom. The beauty of disappointment and never-satisfied love. The cruel beauty of nature and everlasting beauty of monotony.
author: Benjamin Britten

quote: We acquire the strength we have overcome.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Everybody needs beauty as well as bread, places to play in and pray in, where nature may heal and give strength to body and soul.
author: John Muir

quote: Simulated disorder postulates perfect discipline simulated fear postulates courage simulated weakness postulates strength.
author: Lao Tzu

quote: A strong man doesn't have to be dominant toward a woman. He doesn't match his strength against a woman weak with love for him. He matches it against the world.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: A nation that destroys its soils destroys itself. Forests are the lungs of our land, purifying the air and giving fresh strength to our people.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quote: The real man smiles in trouble, gathers strength from distress, and grows brave by reflection.
author: Thomas Paine

quote: My strength has the strength of ten because my heart is pure.
author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

quote: It does not take much strength to do things, but it requires great strength to decide on what to do.
author: Elbert Hubbard

quote: Tears shed for self are tears of weakness, but tears shed for others are a sign of strength.
author: Billy Graham

quote: A hero is an ordinary individual who finds the strength to persevere and endure in spite of overwhelming obstacles.
author: Christopher Reeve

quote: My family is my strength and my weakness.
author: Aishwarya Rai

quote: Physical strength can never permanently withstand the impact of spiritual force.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quote: Greatness lies, not in being strong, but in the right using of strength and strength is not used rightly when it serves only to carry a man above his fellows for his own solitary glory. He is the greatest whose strength carries up the most hearts by the attraction of his own.
author: Henry Ward Beecher

quote: Love feels no burden, thinks nothing of trouble, attempts what is above its strength, pleads no excuse of impossibility for it thinks all things lawful for itself, and all things possible.
author: Thomas a Kempis

quote: Unity is strength... when there is teamwork and collaboration, wonderful things can be achieved.
author: Mattie Stepanek

quote: Youngsters of the age of two and three are endowed with extraordinary strength. They can lift a dog twice their own weight and dump him into the bathtub.
author: Erma Bombeck

quote: Ronald Reagan was a president of strength. His philosophy was a philosophy of strength - a strong military, a strong economy and strong families.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: Give us grace and strength to forbear and to persevere. Give us courage and gaiety and the quiet mind, spare to us our friends, soften to us our enemies.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quote: Where is the man who has the strength to be true, and to show himself as he is?
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: My mother taught me about the power of inspiration and courage, and she did it with a strength and a passion that I wish could be bottled.
author: Carly Fiorina

quote: My greatest strength is common sense. I'm really a standard brand - like Campbell's tomato soup or Baker's chocolate.
author: Katharine Hepburn

quote: The strength and power of despotism consists wholly in the fear of resistance.
author: Thomas Paine

quote: The turning point in the process of growing up is when you discover the core of strength within you that survives all hurt.
author: Max Lerner

quote: You can tell the strength of a nation by the women behind its men.
author: Benjamin Disraeli

quote: The strength and power and goodness of America has always been based on the strength and power and goodness of our communities, our families, our faiths. That is the bedrock of what makes America, America. In our best days, we can feel the vibrancy of America's communities, large and small.
author: Mitt Romney

quote: Religion is an illusion and it derives its strength from the fact that it falls in with our instinctual desires.
author: Sigmund Freud

quote: Atheism shows strength of mind, but only to a certain degree.
author: Blaise Pascal

quote: He is greatest whose strength carries up the most hearts by the attraction of his own.
author: Henry Ward Beecher

quote: Those who have the strength and the love to sit with a dying patient in the silence that goes beyond words will know that this moment is neither frightening nor painful, but a peaceful cessation of the functioning of the body.
author: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

quote: Wondrous is the strength of cheerfulness, and its power of endurance - the cheerful man will do more in the same time, will do it better, will preserve it longer, than the sad or sullen.
author: Thomas Carlyle

quote: People do not lack strength they lack will.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: Unless India stands up to the world, no one will respect us. In this world, fear has no place. Only strength respects strength.
author: Abdul Kalam

quote: My greatest strength as a consultant is to be ignorant and ask a few questions.
author: Peter Drucker

quote: The strength of a man's virtue should not be measured by his special exertions, but by his habitual acts.
author: Blaise Pascal

quote: All too often arrogance accompanies strength, and we must never assume that justice is on the side of the strong. The use of power must always be accompanied by moral choice.
author: Theodore Bikel

quote: Endurance is nobler than strength, and patience than beauty.
author: John Ruskin

quote: The spirit of man is more important than mere physical strength, and the spiritual fiber of a nation than its wealth.
author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

quote: Remember, the storm is a good opportunity for the pine and the cypress to show their strength and their stability.
author: Ho Chi Minh

quote: Being forced to work, and forced to do your best, will breed in you temperance and self-control, diligence and strength of will, cheerfulness and content, and a hundred virtues which the idle will never know.
author: Charles Kingsley

quote: Only strength can cooperate. Weakness can only beg.
author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

quote: Our real problem, then, is not our strength today it is rather the vital necessity of action today to ensure our strength tomorrow.
author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

quote: Great works are performed not by strength but by perseverance.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: African women in general need to know that it's OK for them to be the way they are - to see the way they are as a strength, and to be liberated from fear and from silence.
author: Wangari Maathai

quote: Each relationship nurtures a strength or weakness within you.
author: Mike Murdock

quote: True strength lies in submission which permits one to dedicate his life, through devotion, to something beyond himself.
author: Henry Miller

quote: And when a woman's will is as strong as the man's who wants to govern her, half her strength must be concealment.
author: George Eliot

quote: Strength of mind rests in sobriety for this keeps your reason unclouded by passion.
author: Pythagoras

quote: If we resist our passions, it is more due to their weakness than our strength.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quote: We all have enough strength to endure the misfortunes of others.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quote: When it comes to developing character strength, inner security and unique personal and interpersonal talents and skills in a child, no institution can or ever will compare with, or effectively substitute for, the home's potential for positive influence.
author: Stephen Covey

quote: In all human affairs there are efforts, and there are results, and the strength of the effort is the measure of the result.
author: James Allen

quote: We are born weak, we need strength helpless, we need aid foolish, we need reason. All that we lack at birth, all that we need when we come to man's estate, is the gift of education.
author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quote: Aging is not lost youth but a new stage of opportunity and strength.
author: Betty Friedan

quote: The strength and power of a country depends absolutely on the quantity of good men and women in it.
author: John Ruskin

quote: Our strength is often composed of the weakness that we're damned if we're going to show.
author: Mignon McLaughlin

quote: One ever feels his twoness - an American, a Negro two souls, two thoughts, two unreconciled strivings two warring ideals in one dark body, whose dogged strength alone keeps it from being torn asunder.
author: W. E. B. Du Bois

quote: I think a hero is an ordinary individual who finds strength to persevere and endure in spite of overwhelming obstacles.
author: Christopher Reeve

quote: Eccentricity has always abounded when and where strength of character had abounded and the amount of eccentricity in a society has generally been proportional to the amount of genius, mental vigor, and courage which it contained.
author: John Stuart Mill

quote: Love you will find only where you may show yourself weak without provoking strength.
author: Theodor Adorno

quote: Method is more important than strength, when you wish to control your enemies. By dropping golden beads near a snake, a crow once managed To have a passer-by kill the snake for the beads.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quote: Music makes us want to live. You don't know how many times people have told me that they'd been down and depressed and just wanted to die. But then a special song caught their ear and that helped give them renewed strength. That's the power music has.
author: Mary J. Blige

quote: You're blessed if you have the strength to work.
author: Mahalia Jackson

quote: To be capable of steady friendship or lasting love, are the two greatest proofs, not only of goodness of heart, but of strength of mind.
author: William Hazlitt

quote: The kind of beauty I want most is the hard-to-get kind that comes from within - strength, courage, dignity.
author: Ruby Dee

quote: Whoever knows it also knows that in love there is no More and no Less but that he who loves can only love with the whole heart, and with the whole soul with all his strength and with all his will.
author: Max Muller

quote: All species capable of grasping this fact manage better in the struggle for existence than those which rely upon their own strength alone: the wolf, which hunts in a pack, has a greater chance of survival than the lion, which hunts alone.
author: Christian Lous Lange

quote: 'Tis skill, not strength, that governs a ship.
author: Thomas Fuller

quote: The awareness of our own strength makes us modest.
author: Paul Cezanne

quote: A powerful idea communicates some of its strength to him who challenges it.
author: Marcel Proust

quote: It is only necessary to have courage, for strength without self-confidence is useless.
author: Giacomo Casanova

quote: When I dare to be powerful - to use my strength in the service of my vision, then it becomes less and less important whether I am afraid.
author: Audre Lorde

quote: Many a man's strength is in opposition, and when he faileth, he grows out of use.
author: Francis Bacon

quote: The superior man is the providence of the inferior. He is eyes for the blind, strength for the weak, and a shield for the defenseless. He stands erect by bending above the fallen. He rises by lifting others.
author: Robert Green Ingersoll

quote: A nation' s strength ultimately consists in what it can do on its own, and not in what it can borrow from others.
author: Indira Gandhi

quote: It is a sign of contraction of the mind when it is content, or of weariness. A spirited mind never stops within itself it is always aspiring and going beyond its strength.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: Patience is the support of weakness impatience the ruin of strength.
author: Charles Caleb Colton

quote: Willingness to change is a strength, even if it means plunging part of the company into total confusion for a while.
author: Jack Welch

quote: I look at an ant and I see myself: a native South African, endowed by nature with a strength much greater than my size so I might cope with the weight of a racism that crushes my spirit.
author: Miriam Makeba

quote: To have ego means to believe in your own strength. And to also be open to other people's views. It is to be open, not closed. So, yes, my ego is big, but it's also very small in some areas. My ego is responsible for my doing what I do - bad or good.
author: Barbra Streisand

quote: Freedom and order are not incompatible... truth is strength... free discussion is the very life of truth.
author: Thomas Huxley

quote: Nothing has more strength than dire necessity.
author: Euripides

quote: The wisest use of American strength is to advance freedom.
author: George W. Bush

quote: Although men are accused of not knowing their own weakness, yet perhaps few know their own strength. It is in men as in soils, where sometimes there is a vein of gold which the owner knows not of.
author: Jonathan Swift

quote: I understand now that the vulnerability I've always felt is the greatest strength a person can have. You can't experience life without feeling life. What I've learned is that being vulnerable to somebody you love is not a weakness, it's a strength.
author: Elisabeth Shue

quote: Suppressed grief suffocates, it rages within the breast, and is forced to multiply its strength.
author: Ovid

quote: There comes a pause, for human strength will not endure to dance without cessation and everyone must reach the point at length of absolute prostration.
author: Lewis Carroll

quote: Organic buildings are the strength and lightness of the spiders' spinning, buildings qualified by light, bred by native character to environment, married to the ground.
author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quote: Leaders come in many forms, with many styles and diverse qualities. There are quiet leaders and leaders one can hear in the next county. Some find strength in eloquence, some in judgment, some in courage.
author: John W. Gardner

quote: Mohammed was not an apparent failure. He was a dazzling success, politically as well as spiritually, and Islam went from strength to strength to strength.
author: Karen Armstrong

quote: The financial crisis should not become an excuse to raise taxes, which would only undermine the economic growth required to regain our strength.
author: George W. Bush

quote: Religious beliefs evolved by group-selection, tribe competing against tribe, and the illogic of religions is not a weakness but their essential strength.
author: E. O. Wilson

quote: The freedom to fail is vital if you're going to succeed. Most successful people fail from time to time, and it is a measure of their strength that failure merely propels them into some new attempt at success.
author: Michael Korda

quote: It doesn't take a lot of strength to hang on. It takes a lot of strength to let go.
author: J. C. Watts

quote: We draw our strength from the very despair in which we have been forced to live. We shall endure.
author: Cesar Chavez

quote: One column of truth cannot hold an institution of ideas from falling into ignorance. It is wiser that a person of prudence and purpose save his strength for battles that can be won.
author: Bryant H. McGill

quote: Let us speak, though we show all our faults and weaknesses, - for it is a sign of strength to be weak, to know it, and out with it - not in a set way and ostentatiously, though, but incidentally and without premeditation.
author: Herman Melville

quote: The strength of criticism lies in the weakness of the thing criticized.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quote: Work is not man's punishment. It is his reward and his strength and his pleasure.
author: George Sand

quote: Life always rides in strength to victory, not through internationalism... but only through the direct responsibility of the individual.
author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quote: I like a women who's got some balls, some strength. As long as I can beat her at arm wrestling, that's fine.
author: James Hetfield

quote: Strength instead of being the lusty child of passion, grows by grappling with and subduing them.
author: James M. Barrie

quote: Many people think they want things, but they don't really have the strength, the discipline. They are weak. I believe that you get what you want if you want it badly enough.
author: Sophia Loren

quote: The separation of church and state is a source of strength, but the conscience of our nation does not call for separation between men of state and faith in the Supreme Being.
author: Lyndon B. Johnson

quote: In this outward and physical ceremony we attest once again to the inner and spiritual strength of our Nation. As my high school teacher, Miss Julia Coleman, used to say: 'We must adjust to changing times and still hold to unchanging principles.'
author: Jimmy Carter

quote: The depth and strength of a human character are defined by its moral reserves. People reveal themselves completely only when they are thrown out of the customary conditions of their life, for only then do they have to fall back on their reserves.
author: Leon Trotsky

quote: I know there is strength in the differences between us. I know there is comfort where we overlap.
author: Ani DiFranco

quote: If you would know strength and patience, welcome the company of trees.
author: Hal Borland

quote: The man who is swimming against the stream knows the strength of it.
author: Woodrow Wilson

quote: Courage conquers all things: it even gives strength to the body.
author: Ovid

quote: Our passion is our strength.
author: Billie Joe Armstrong

quote: Not one man in a thousand has the strength of mind or the goodness of heart to be an atheist.
author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

quote: Credulity is the man's weakness, but the child's strength.
author: Charles Lamb

quote: There are movements which impinge upon the nerves with a strength that is incomparable, for movement has power to stir the senses and emotions, unique in itself.
author: Doris Humphrey

quote: I'm not just a doormat. I'm not just being stepped on all over the place. If you look at the bulk of my material, it's about trying to find some strength through that.
author: Lucinda Williams

quote: I report to you that our country is challenged at home and abroad: that it is our will that is being tried and not our strength our sense of purpose and not our ability to achieve a better America.
author: Lyndon B. Johnson

quote: Sometimes the strength of motherhood is greater than natural laws.
author: Barbara Kingsolver

quote: He knows not his own strength that hath not met adversity.
author: Cesare Pavese

quote: Even as we enumerate their shortcomings, the rigor of raising children ourselves makes clear to us our mothers' incredible strength. We fear both. If they are not strong, who will protect us? If they are not imperfect, how can we equal them?
author: Anna Quindlen

quote: When strength is yoked with justice, where is a mightier pair than they?
author: Aeschylus

quote: Men are apt to mistake the strength of their feeling for the strength of their argument. The heated mind resents the chill touch and relentless scrutiny of logic.
author: William E. Gladstone

quote: 'Charm' - which means the power to effect work without employing brute force - is indispensable to women. Charm is a woman's strength just as strength is a man's charm.
author: Havelock Ellis

quote: Power is not an institution, and not a structure neither is it a certain strength we are endowed with it is the name that one attributes to a complex strategical situation in a particular society.
author: Michel Foucault

quote: While President Bush likes to project an image of strength and courage, the real truth is that in the presence of his large financial contributors, he is a moral coward.
author: Al Gore

quote: It's being willing to walk away that gives you strength and power - if you're willing to accept the consequences of doing what you want to do.
author: Whoopi Goldberg

quote: Lust is to the other passions what the nervous fluid is to life it supports them all, lends strength to them all ambition, cruelty, avarice, revenge, are all founded on lust.
author: Marquis de Sade

quote: Power is so characteristically calm, that calmness in itself has the aspect of strength.
author: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

quote: That strange feeling we had in the war. Have you found anything in your lives since to equal it in strength? A sort of splendid carelessness it was, holding us together.
author: Noel Coward

quote: Conscience is a coward, and those faults it has not strength enough to prevent it seldom has justice enough to accuse.
author: Oliver Goldsmith

quote: It is wonderful what strength of purpose and boldness and energy of will are roused by the assurance that we are doing our duty.
author: Walter Scott

quote: From the depth of need and despair, people can work together, can organize themselves to solve their own problems and fill their own needs with dignity and strength.
author: Cesar Chavez

quote: Calm, open debate, and logical thought drive strength to its maximum effectiveness.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: I do think the heart can balance out the mind, if your heart is in a good place it can give you the strength to do the right thing and behave the right way and overcome the mind.
author: Alexis Arguello

quote: Will power is only the tensile strength of one's own disposition. One cannot increase it by a single ounce.
author: Cesare Pavese

quote: Strength is born in the deep silence of long-suffering hearts not amid joy.
author: Arthur Helps

quote: Only actions give life strength only moderation gives it charm.
author: Jean Paul

quote: Let me tell you the secret that has led me to my goal. My strength lies solely in my tenacity.
author: Louis Pasteur

quote: You really have to look inside yourself and find your own inner strength, and say, 'I'm proud of what I am and who I am, and I'm just going to be myself.'
author: Mariah Carey

quote: Knowledge is not a passion from without the mind, but an active exertion of the inward strength, vigor and power of the mind, displaying itself from within.
author: Ralph Cudworth

quote: America's strength is not our diversity our strength is our ability to unite people of different backgrounds around common principles. A common language is necessary to reach that goal.
author: Ernest Istook

quote: To be loved is a strength. To love is a weakness.
author: Zsa Zsa Gabor

quote: The five separate fingers are five independent units. Close them and the fist multiplies strength. This is organization.
author: James Cash Penney

quote: Libraries are reservoirs of strength, grace and wit, reminders of order, calm and continuity, lakes of mental energy, neither warm nor cold, light nor dark.
author: Germaine Greer

quote: Strengthen me by sympathizing with my strength, not my weakness.
author: Amos Bronson Alcott

quote: Don't be intimidated by what you don't know. That can be your greatest strength and ensure that you do things differently from everyone else.
author: Sara Blakely

quote: When you call upon a Thoroughbred, he gives you all the speed, strength of heart and sinew in him. When you call on a jackass, he kicks.
author: Patricia Neal

quote: Wisdom is always an overmatch for strength.
author: Phil Jackson

quote: Yes, forget your weakness, whatever that weakness may be. It is egotism, it is selfishness after. all, for it is a dwelling on self. Forget your weakness and remember your strength.
author: Joseph Barber Lightfoot

quote: A lot of guys have muscles. A lot of strong men in this world. I think it's important to show that even under all this strength there's a fragile side, a side that can be affected.
author: Sylvester Stallone

quote: If you put all your strength and faith and vigor into a job and try to do the best you can, the money will come.
author: Lawrence Welk

quote: All the strength and force of man comes from his faith in things unseen. He who believes is strong he who doubts is weak. Strong convictions precede great actions.
author: James Freeman Clarke

quote: I know now what this meant, that the bison were the gift of a good spirit and were our strength, but we should lose them, and from the same good spirit we must find another strength.
author: Black Elk

quote: Let a woman have her place, because as you provide foundation for her, she provides a foundation for you. And through that vulnerability comes strength.
author: Shemar Moore

quote: Liturgy is like a strong tree whose beauty is derived from the continuous renewal of its leaves, but whose strength comes from the old trunk, with solid roots in the ground.
author: Pope Paul VI

quote: The failure of academic feminists to recognize difference as a crucial strength is a failure to reach beyond the first patriarchal lesson. In our world, divide and conquer must become define and empower.
author: Audre Lorde

quote: I think that we had a different view of what the 21st century could be like, with much more of a sense, from our perspective, of trying to have an interdependent world: looking at solving regional conflicts, having strength in alliances, operating within some kind of a sense that we were part of the international community and not outside of it.
author: Madeleine Albright

quote: It is a maudlin and indecent verity that comes out through the strength of wine.
author: Joseph Conrad

quote: In solitude the mind gains strength and learns to lean upon itself.
author: Laurence Sterne

quote: Quarreling over food and drink, having neither scruples nor shame, not knowing right from wrong, not trying to avoid death or injury, not fearful of greater strength or of greater numbers, greedily aware only of food and drink - such is the bravery of the dog and boar.
author: Xun Zi

quote: I had a vision with which I might have saved my people, but I had not the strength to do it.
author: Black Elk

quote: There is always strength in numbers. The more individuals or organizations that you can rally to your cause, the better.
author: Mark Shields

quote: It's always difficult to play a scene of physical violence because you're always afraid that you don't know your own strength and might hurt someone.
author: Catherine Deneuve

quote: From the gut comes the strut, and where hunger reigns, strength abstains.
author: Francois Rabelais

quote: I have arm-wrestled here and there... guys seem to want to test my strength.
author: Shania Twain

quote: I have the people behind me and the people are my strength.
author: Huey Newton

quote: People confuse goodness with weakness. It is weak people, not good people (goodness demands strength), who are taken advantage of.
author: Dennis Prager

quote: Each is under the most sacred obligation not to squander the material committed to him, not to sap his strength in folly and vice, and to see at the least that he delivers a product worthy the labor and cost which have been expended on him.
author: Anna Julia Cooper

quote: The apple cannot be stuck back on the Tree of Knowledge once we begin to see, we are doomed and challenged to seek the strength to see more, not less.
author: Arthur Miller

quote: People think of Latina women as being fiery and fierce, which is usually true. But I think the quality that so many Latinas possess is strength. I'm very proud to have Latin blood.
author: Zoe Saldana

quote: Strength does not have to be belligerent and loud.
author: Russell Brand

quote: A strength to harm is perilous in the hand of an ambitious head.
author: Elizabeth I

quote: I've been playing against older and stronger competition my whole life. It has made me a better tennis player and able to play against this kind of level despite their strength and experience.
author: Maria Sharapova

quote: Each blade of grass has its spot on earth whence it draws its life, its strength and so is man rooted to the land from which he draws his faith together with his life.
author: Joseph Conrad

quote: I couldn't beat people with my strength I don't have a hard shot I'm not the quickest skater in the league. My eyes and my mind have to do most of the work.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: It may be that religion is dead, and if it is, we had better know it and set ourselves to try to discover other sources of moral strength before it is too late.
author: Pearl S. Buck

quote: The breaking wave and the muscle as it contracts obey the same law. Delicate line gathers the body's total strength in a bold balance. Shall my soul meet so severe a curve, journeying on its way to form?
author: Dag Hammarskjold

quote: Organized religion is a sham and a crutch for weak-minded people who need strength in numbers. It tells people to go out and stick their noses in other people's business.
author: Jesse Ventura

quote: Some great men owe most of their greatness to the ability of detecting in those they destine for their tools the exact quality of strength that matters for their work.
author: Joseph Conrad

quote: Our firm conviction that ours is a just cause and that we must find a peaceful way to attain our goals gave us the strength and the awareness of the limits beyond which we must not go.
author: Lech Walesa

quote: Women have seldom sufficient employment to silence their feelings a round of little cares, or vain pursuits frittering away all strength of mind and organs, they become naturally only objects of sense.
author: Mary Wollstonecraft

quote: I challenge anybody to say that I wouldn't know how to approach foreign policy because, unlike some of the other people, I at least have a foreign policy philosophy, which is an extension of the Reagan philosophy. Peace through strength, and my philosophy is peace through strength and clarity.
author: Herman Cain

quote: Peace is purchased from strength. It's not purchased from weakness or unilateral retreats.
author: Benjamin Netanyahu

quote: Some say that I should settle down, go slower and not push so hard, so quickly for such transformational change. To them, I say that you misunderstand the size of the problems we face, the strength of the status quo and the urgency of the people's desire for change.
author: Eliot Spitzer

quote: As thy days, so shall thy strength be which, in modern language, may be translated as thy thoughts so shall thy life be.
author: Emmet Fox

quote: An American, a Negro... two souls, two thoughts, two unreconciled strivings two warring ideals in one dark body, whose dogged strength alone keeps it from being torn asunder.
author: W. E. B. Du Bois

quote: Few men during their lifetime comes anywhere near exhausting the resources dwelling within them. There are deep wells of strength that are never used.
author: Richard E. Byrd

quote: My practicality consists in this, in the knowledge that if you beat your head against the wall it is your head which breaks and not the wall - that is my strength, my only strength.
author: Antonio Gramsci

quote: Obama won the presidency on the strength of his message and the skills of the messenger. Now the talk of hope and change feels out of tune when so many Americans are out of work, over-mortgaged, and worried that life will be even tougher for their children.
author: Ron Fournier
